<!-- Keystone Renovations: Elementor HTML widget content -->
<style>

/* ============ FONTS (self-hosted, embedded) ============ */
@font-face{font-family:'Fraunces';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;}
@font-face{font-family:'Fraunces';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;}
@font-face{font-family:'Fraunces';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:500;font-style:italic;font-display:swap;}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;}
@font-face{font-family:'Inter';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;}
@font-face{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono';src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');font-weight:500;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;}

/* ============ TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --obsidian:#061F19;
  --forest:#02352A;
  --forest-light:#0E4A3A;
  --forest-border:#1C5645;
  --mint:#7FE8C8;
  --mint-deep:#4FC8A4;
  --bronze:#C9A972;
  --bronze-deep:#A6875A;
  --bone:#F4F0E4;
  --bone-dim:#E6E0CE;
  --ink:#0B211B;
  --mist:#A8C9BC;
  --mist-dim:#729184;

  --font-display:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;
  --font-body:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --font-mono:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;

  --wedge: polygon(14px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 14px), calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 14px);
  --wedge-sm: polygon(8px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 8px), calc(100% - 8px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 8px);
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
  background:var(--obsidian);
  color:var(--bone);
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
ul{list-style:none;}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--mint);outline-offset:3px;}

.wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px;}
.eyebrow{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);
  font-size:12.5px;
  letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--mint);
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  margin-bottom:18px;
}
.eyebrow::before{content:'';width:22px;height:1px;background:var(--mint);display:inline-block;}
.eyebrow.on-bone{color:var(--bronze-deep);}
.eyebrow.on-bone::before{background:var(--bronze-deep);}

h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:900;line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:-.01em;}
h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,50px);}
h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:600;}
p{color:var(--mist);}
.on-bone p{color:#4B6157;}

.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:17px 30px;
  clip-path:var(--wedge);
  transition:transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, background .25s ease;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.btn-primary{background:var(--mint);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--mint-deep);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--bone);border:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--mint);color:var(--mint);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.btn-bronze{background:var(--bronze);color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;}
.btn-bronze:hover{background:var(--mint);}

/* ============ VOUSSOIR DIVIDER ============ */
.joint{
  display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:3px;
  padding:22px 0;
  background:var(--obsidian);
}
.joint span{width:9px;height:16px;background:var(--forest-border);clip-path:polygon(30% 0,70% 0,100% 100%,0% 100%);}
.joint.on-forest{background:var(--forest);}
.joint.on-bone{background:var(--bone);}
.joint.on-bone span{background:var(--bronze);opacity:.5;}
.joint.on-pine{background:var(--forest-light);}

/* ============ NAV ============ */
header{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:100;
  transition:background .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, border-color .3s ease;
  border-bottom:1px solid transparent;
}
header.scrolled{background:rgba(6,31,25,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-color:var(--forest-border);}
nav{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:16px 40px;max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;
}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;}
.brand img{width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:2px;}
.brand .word{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:900;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.02em;}
.brand .word span{color:var(--mint);}
.brand .sub{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--mist-dim);display:block;margin-top:1px;}

.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:38px;}
.nav-links a{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mist);position:relative;padding:4px 0;transition:color .2s;}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--mint);}
.nav-links a::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--mint);transition:width .25s ease;}
.nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%;}

.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;}
.nav-phone{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:14px;color:var(--bone);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
.nav-phone svg{width:15px;height:15px;stroke:var(--mint);}
.nav-toggle{display:none;}

/* ============ HERO ============ */
.hero{
  position:relative;
  min-height:920px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;
  padding:170px 0 90px;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 500px at 78% 18%, rgba(127,232,200,.10), transparent 60%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,var(--obsidian) 0%, #041A15 100%);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.hero::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(127,232,200,.05) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(127,232,200,.05) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size:64px 64px;
  mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0,0,0,.7) 40%, transparent 90%);
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-grid{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;
  position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;
}
.hero h1{
  font-size:clamp(44px,5.6vw,76px);
  color:var(--bone);
  margin-bottom:26px;
}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;font-weight:500;color:var(--mint);}
.hero .lede{
  font-size:18px;max-width:480px;margin-bottom:40px;color:var(--mist);
}
.hero .cta-row{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:64px;}

.hero-stats{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,auto);gap:36px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--forest-border);padding-top:28px;max-width:560px;
}
.hero-stats .num{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:900;font-size:30px;color:var(--mint);display:block;}
.hero-stats .lbl{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--mist-dim);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px;display:block;}

.hero-art{position:relative;z-index:1;}
.hero-art svg{width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;}
.voussoir{fill:none;stroke:var(--forest-border);stroke-width:1.3;}
.key-stone{fill:rgba(127,232,200,.14);stroke:var(--mint);stroke-width:1.6;}
.skyline-bar{fill:var(--forest);}
.skyline-bar.hi{fill:var(--forest-light);}
.arch-label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;fill:var(--mist-dim);letter-spacing:.1em;}
.arch-label.hot{fill:var(--mint);}

/* ============ SERVICES ============ */
.services{background:var(--forest);padding:120px 0;position:relative;}
.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:40px;margin-bottom:64px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.section-head h2{max-width:600px;}
.section-head .sub{max-width:340px;font-size:15px;padding-bottom:6px;}

.svc-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--forest-border);border:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.svc-card{
  background:var(--forest);
  padding:38px 30px 32px;
  position:relative;
  transition:background .3s ease;
  min-height:250px;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.svc-card:hover{background:var(--forest-light);}
.svc-num{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--bronze);letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:22px;}
.svc-card h3{color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:12px;font-size:19px;}
.svc-card p{font-size:14px;color:var(--mist);flex-grow:1;}
.svc-tag{width:30px;height:30px;position:relative;margin-bottom:0;}
.svc-icon{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:var(--mint);stroke-width:1.5;fill:none;}

/* ============ ABOUT + PROCESS (paper section) ============ */
.paper{background:var(--bone);color:var(--ink);padding:130px 0 0;}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:80px;padding-bottom:110px;border-bottom:1px solid #DCD6C2;}
.about-figure{
  background:var(--ink);clip-path:var(--wedge);padding:44px 36px;position:relative;height:fit-content;
}
.about-figure .quote{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:500;font-size:23px;color:var(--mint);line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:28px;}
.about-figure .attrib{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mist-dim);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;}
.about-stats{margin-top:34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;border-top:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.about-stats div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.about-stats .n{font-family:var(--font-mono);color:var(--mint);font-size:13px;}
.about-stats .l{font-family:var(--font-mono);color:var(--mist-dim);font-size:12px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;}

.about-copy h2{margin-bottom:26px;color:var(--ink);}
.about-copy p{color:#4B6157;font-size:16.5px;margin-bottom:18px;max-width:560px;}
.about-copy p:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}

.process{padding:110px 0 130px;}
.process-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:28px;margin-top:60px;}
.p-step{position:relative;padding-top:28px;}
.p-step::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:56px;height:34px;background:var(--ink);
  clip-path:polygon(18% 0,82% 0,100% 100%,0% 100%);
}
.p-step .pn{position:absolute;top:6px;left:0;width:56px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--font-mono);color:var(--mint);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;}
.p-step h3{margin:20px 0 12px;font-size:18px;color:var(--ink);}
.p-step p{font-size:14.5px;color:#5C7268;}
.p-step:not(:last-child){border-right:1px dashed #D2CBB4;padding-right:24px;}

/* ============ SERVICE AREA ============ */
.area{background:var(--obsidian);padding:130px 0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.area-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:70px;align-items:center;}
.area-copy h2{color:var(--bone);margin-bottom:22px;}
.area-copy p{font-size:16.5px;max-width:480px;margin-bottom:30px;}
.area-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
.area-list span{
  font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid var(--forest-border);color:var(--mist);
  clip-path:var(--wedge-sm);
}
.area-list span.hq{border-color:var(--mint);color:var(--mint);}

.area-map svg{width:100%;height:auto;}
.ab-outline{fill:rgba(127,232,200,.04);stroke:var(--forest-border);stroke-width:1.2;}
.ab-grid-line{stroke:var(--forest-border);stroke-width:.6;opacity:.5;}
.city-dot{fill:var(--mint);}
.city-dot.hq{fill:var(--bronze);}
.city-ring{fill:none;stroke:var(--mint);stroke-width:1;opacity:.5;}
.city-label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:12.5px;fill:var(--bone);letter-spacing:.03em;}
.city-label.hq{fill:var(--bronze);font-weight:500;}
.city-tag{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:9.5px;fill:var(--mist-dim);letter-spacing:.08em;}

/* ============ TRUST STRIP ============ */
.trust{background:var(--forest-light);padding:0;}
.trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);}
.trust-item{
  padding:38px 30px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
  border-right:1px solid var(--forest-border);
}
.trust-item:last-child{border-right:none;}
.trust-item svg{width:28px;height:28px;stroke:var(--mint);fill:none;stroke-width:1.4;flex-shrink:0;}
.trust-item .t{font-family:var(--font-body);font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--bone);}
.trust-item .d{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--mist-dim);margin-top:2px;}

/* ============ CONTACT ============ */
.contact{background:var(--obsidian);padding:130px 0;}
.contact-panel{
  background:var(--forest);
  clip-path:polygon(28px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 28px),calc(100% - 28px) 100%,0 100%,0 28px);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;
  border:1px solid var(--forest-border);
}
.contact-info{padding:64px 54px;border-right:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.contact-info h2{color:var(--bone);font-size:34px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.contact-info p{font-size:15.5px;margin-bottom:36px;max-width:400px;}
.c-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.c-row:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.c-row svg{width:19px;height:19px;stroke:var(--mint);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0;}
.c-row .k{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--mist-dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;display:block;margin-bottom:3px;}
.c-row .v{font-size:15.5px;color:var(--bone);}
.c-row a:hover{color:var(--mint);}

.contact-form{padding:64px 54px;}
.form-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-bottom:20px;}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;}
.field.full{grid-column:1/-1;}
.field label{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mist-dim);}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{
  background:var(--obsidian);border:1px solid var(--forest-border);color:var(--bone);
  padding:13px 15px;font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:14.5px;transition:border-color .2s;
}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--mint);}
.field textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:100px;}
.contact-form .btn{margin-top:6px;width:100%;}

/* ============ FOOTER ============ */
footer{background:#041712;padding:70px 0 30px;border-top:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr .8fr .8fr 1fr;gap:50px;padding-bottom:54px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
.foot-brand .brand{margin-bottom:18px;}
.foot-brand p{font-size:14px;max-width:280px;color:var(--mist-dim);}
.foot-col h4{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--bronze);margin-bottom:20px;font-weight:500;}
.foot-col ul li{margin-bottom:12px;}
.foot-col ul a{font-size:14px;color:var(--mist);transition:color .2s;}
.foot-col ul a:hover{color:var(--mint);}
.foot-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
.foot-bottom p{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mist-dim);}

/* ============ REVEAL ANIM ============ */
.rv{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease;}
.rv.pre{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.rv{opacity:1 !important;transform:none !important;transition:none !important;} html{scroll-behavior:auto;}}

/* ============ RESPONSIVE ============ */
@media (max-width:1080px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .hero-art{max-width:520px;}
  .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .about{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:50px;}
  .process-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);row-gap:44px;}
  .p-step:nth-child(2n)::after{content:none;}
  .p-step:not(:last-child){border-right:none;padding-right:0;}
  .area-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  .trust-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
  .contact-panel{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .contact-info{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--forest-border);}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;row-gap:40px;}
}
@media (max-width:720px){
  .wrap{padding:0 22px;}
  nav{padding:14px 22px;}
  .nav-links{display:none;}
  .nav-phone{display:none;}
  .brand .sub{display:none;}
  .brand .word{font-size:16px;}
  .btn{padding:13px 20px;font-size:12px;}
  .hero{padding:150px 0 70px;min-height:auto;}
  .hero-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px;}
  .svc-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .form-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .contact-info,.contact-form{padding:40px 26px;}
  .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:34px;}
  .foot-bottom{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}
  .section-head{margin-bottom:44px;}
  .process-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .trust-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
}
</style>

<main id="top">
<!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
<section class="hero">
<div class="wrap hero-grid">
<div class="hero-copy">
<p class="eyebrow">Calgary, AB  ·  Edmonton  ·  Red Deer  ·  Alberta-Wide</p>
<h1 class="rv">Every structure<br/>needs <em>a keystone.</em></h1>
<p class="lede rv">For 20 years, Keystone Renovations has been the load-bearing partner behind Alberta's best-built homes and commercial spaces — from foundation work to the final coat of paint.</p>
<div class="cta-row rv">
<a class="btn btn-primary" href="#contact">Request a Free Quote</a>
<a class="btn btn-ghost" href="#services">See What We Build</a>
</div>
<div class="hero-stats rv">
<div><span class="num">20+</span><span class="lbl">Years in the Trade</span></div>
<div><span class="num">500+</span><span class="lbl">Projects Completed</span></div>
<div><span class="num">100%</span><span class="lbl">Licensed &amp; Insured</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="hero-art rv">
<svg viewbox="0 0 600 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<!-- skyline -->
<g>
<rect class="skyline-bar" height="60" width="26" x="30" y="330"></rect>
<rect class="skyline-bar hi" height="90" width="22" x="62" y="300"></rect>
<rect class="skyline-bar" height="45" width="18" x="90" y="345"></rect>
<rect class="skyline-bar hi" height="80" width="24" x="480" y="310"></rect>
<rect class="skyline-bar" height="55" width="20" x="510" y="335"></rect>
<rect class="skyline-bar" height="40" width="16" x="536" y="350"></rect>

<!-- ============ ABOUT + PROCESS ============ -->
<section class="paper" id="about">
<div class="wrap about">
<div class="about-figure rv">
<p class="quote">"The crew that shows up should be the crew that finishes the job."</p>
<p class="attrib">— Keystone Renovations, founding principle</p>
<div class="about-stats">
<div><span class="l">Years Operating in Alberta</span><span class="n">20+</span></div>
<div><span class="l">Licensed &amp; Insured Crew</span><span class="n">100%</span></div>
<div><span class="l">Quotes</span><span class="n">Free, No Pressure</span></div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="about-copy rv">
<p class="eyebrow on-bone">Why Keystone</p>
<h2>Twenty years of building it right the first time.</h2>
<p>Keystone Renovations was built on a simple idea: the people who quote your project are the people who finish it. Over two decades, we've carried that through everything from HVAC upgrades and roof replacements to full residential renovations and ground-up commercial builds across Calgary and the rest of Alberta.</p>
<p>No subcontracting the hard parts. No disappearing after the deposit clears. Every project — whether it's a new basement suite or a full commercial fit-out — gets the same crew from the first walkthrough to the final inspection.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wrap process" id="process">
<div class="section-head rv">
<div>
<p class="eyebrow on-bone">How We Work</p>
<h2 style="color:var(--ink)">From first call to final walkthrough.</h2>
</div>
<p class="sub" style="color:#5C7268">Four stages, same as building an arch: every step has to hold before the next one goes on.</p>
</div>
<div class="process-grid">
<div class="p-step rv"><span class="pn">01</span><h3>Consult</h3><p>We walk the site, listen to what you actually need, and give you a straight quote — no inflated number to negotiate down from.</p></div>
<div class="p-step rv"><span class="pn">02</span><h3>Plan</h3><p>Permits, materials and a realistic timeline, confirmed before a single tool touches your property.</p></div>
<div class="p-step rv"><span class="pn">03</span><h3>Build</h3><p>One crew sees it through, with regular updates so you're never left wondering what's happening behind the tarp.</p></div>
<div class="p-step rv"><span class="pn">04</span><h3>Handover</h3><p>A final walkthrough, a clean site, and a workmanship warranty — not just a wave goodbye.</p></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<script>
  var header = document.getElementById('siteHeader');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
    if(window.scrollY > 30){ header.classList.add('scrolled'); }
    else { header.classList.remove('scrolled'); }
  });

  var els = document.querySelectorAll('.rv');
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  if('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduceMotion){
    els.forEach(function(el){
      var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      if(rect.top > window.innerHeight * 1.05){ el.classList.add('pre'); }
    });
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.remove('pre'); e.target.classList.add('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
      });
    },{threshold:.1});
    els.forEach(function(el){ if(el.classList.contains('pre')) io.observe(el); });
  }

  var form = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
  if(form){
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      var btn = form.querySelector('button');
      btn.textContent = 'Thanks — We\'ll Be In Touch';
    });
  }
</script>
